blocks.name: slmjury.strategies.persona
blocks.lead: Personas: how a persona system prompt changes a judge's verdicts (accuracy and instruction following).

about.html: The persona prompts below are the exact strings used in the experiments. Do not modify them: any change would alter the results.

blocks.name: get_personas
blocks.returns: Dict mapping persona name → system prompt string.

blocks.name: run_persona_evaluation
blocks.sig: (judge_model_key: str, student_results: list[dict], student_model: str, dataset: str, max_tokens: int, persona_name: str, persona_prompt: str, judge: Optional[slmjury.core.judge.JudgeModel] = None, output_dir: Path = Path('results/core/personas')) -> list[dict]
blocks.summary: Run one judge with one persona system prompt and save the verdicts; returns the judgement dicts.

body.html: Saves to `<output_dir>/<judge>/<persona>_<student>_<dataset>_t<max_tokens>.json. Pass a loaded judge` to avoid reloading the model.

blocks.name: run_all_personas
blocks.sig: (judge_model_key: str, student_results: list[dict], student_model: str, dataset: str, max_tokens: int, judge: Optional[slmjury.core.judge.JudgeModel] = None, output_dir: Path = Path('results/core/personas')) -> dict[str, list[dict]]
blocks.summary: Run every persona for one judge, student, dataset and budget; returns {persona: judgement dicts}.

body.html: Pass a loaded `judge` to avoid reloading the model.

blocks.name: slmjury.strategies.ensemble
blocks.lead: Juries: three SLM judges decide each verdict by majority vote.

about.html: Builds every three-judge jury (all C(n,3) combinations) of the top individual judges. The output matches the individual runs, so scripts/run_strategy_evaluation.py --juries scores it the same way.

blocks.name: majority_vote
blocks.summary: "Correct" or "Incorrect" if at least 2 verdicts agree on it, else "Undefined".

blocks.name: load_judgements_by_key
blocks.sig: (model: str, max_tokens: int, judgements_dir: Path = Path('results/core/judgements')) -> dict[tuple[str, str], list[dict]]
blocks.summary: Load one judge's judgement files at one budget, keyed by (student, dataset).

blocks.name: combine_judgements
blocks.sig: (judgements_list: list[dict[tuple[str, str], list[dict]]], model_names: list[str]) -> dict[tuple[str, str], list[dict]]
blocks.summary: Majority-vote the verdicts of 3 judges for every (student, dataset) key all of them have.

body.html: Each item keeps the first judge's fields and adds `individual_verdicts`.

blocks.name: make_ensemble_name
blocks.sig: (models: list[str], token_settings: Optional[dict[str, int]] = None) -> str
blocks.summary: A readable jury name such as 'qwen3-4b-t10+phi4mi-3.8b-t10+qwen2.5-3b-t10'.

body.html: The budgets are added only when `token_settings` is given.

blocks.name: save_ensemble_results
blocks.sig: (combined: dict[tuple[str, str], list[dict]], ensemble_name: str, output_dir: Path = Path('results/core/juries')) -> list[Path]
blocks.summary: Save each (student, dataset) entry to `<output_dir>/<ensemble_name>/<student>_<dataset>.json`; returns the paths.

blocks.name: get_ensemble_judges
blocks.summary: Load ensemble judge config from models.yaml.
blocks.returns: Dict mapping model key → best token setting.

blocks.name: generate_all_ensembles
blocks.summary: Generate majority-vote juries for all C(5,3) = 10 three-model combinations.

body.html: Reads `judgements_dir and writes output_dir (default core/judgements and core/juries in the results folder). python scripts/run_strategy_evaluation.py --juries` evaluates the results.

blocks.name: slmjury.strategies.debate
blocks.lead: Debate: three SLM judges argue over each verdict until they agree (run it with scripts/run_debate.py).

about.html: RCR (Reflect-Critique-Refine) prompting: 3 agents (three different models at temperature 0.0, or one model at 0.0, 0.4 and 0.9) judge each problem, then debate for up to N rounds; problems still split take the majority vote.

blocks.name: get_debate_prompt_template
blocks.summary: Return math, science, or general debate prompt based on dataset.

blocks.name: build_debate_context
blocks.sig: (debate_state: dict, problem_id, agent_id: int, round_num: int) -> tuple[str, str]
blocks.summary: Format the peers' previous-round responses for the debate prompt.

body.html: Returns (own_previous, context), the strings for the prompt placeholders, for agent `agent_id on problem_id`.

blocks.name: check_consensus
blocks.summary: Split the unresolved problems by whether all 3 agents agree; returns (resolved_ids, unresolved_ids).

blocks.name: make_combo_name
blocks.summary: Create a readable combo name for directory/file naming.

blocks.name: run_agent_turn
blocks.sig: (model_key: str, temperature: float, problems: list[dict], round_num: int, dataset_name: str, debate_state: Optional[dict] = None, agent_id: Optional[int] = None, tp_size_override: Optional[int] = None, max_tokens: int = 8192) -> list[dict]
blocks.summary: Run one agent's inference for a debate round in an isolated subprocess; returns judgement dicts.

body.html: `debate_state and agent_id supply the peers' answers after round 0; dataset_name` picks the prompt.

blocks.name: run_agent_turn_same_model
blocks.sig: (model_key: str, temperatures: list[float], problems: list[dict], round_num: int, dataset_name: str, debate_state: Optional[dict] = None, tp_size_override: Optional[int] = None, max_tokens: int = 8192) -> list[list[dict]]
blocks.summary: Run the 3 agents of a same-model configuration (one model, 3 temperatures) in an isolated subprocess.

body.html: Returns one list of judgement dicts per agent.

blocks.name: run_debate
blocks.sig: (combo_models: list[str], combo_temps: list[float], student_results: list[dict], dataset_name: str, tp_size_override: Optional[int] = None, max_tokens: int = 8192) -> dict
blocks.summary: Run the full debate loop for one configuration (3 model keys and 3 temperatures).

body.html: Returns the debate state, with a final verdict for every problem.

blocks.name: save_debate_results
blocks.sig: (combo_name: str, debate_state: dict, student_model: str, dataset: str, output_dir: Path = Path('results/core/debate')) -> Path
blocks.summary: Turn a debate state into final results and save them to `<output_dir>/<combo_name>/<student>_<dataset>.json`.
